summary: The unweighted prototype Wasserstein bound fails even for exact unique k-center solutions. Cluster-mass weights restore a changed bound. Released attention code admits future-token dependence during teacher forcing, and several local numerical summaries disagree with tables; historical benchmark effects are not established.
limitations: Selective static source review only; no author code executed.
No historical LLM/simulator reproduction or confidence-interval validation.
Code causality defect has unknown historical effect; no evaluation-answer leakage alleged.
Weighted repair changes the original equal-center retrieval rule.
No global proof of top-K rank preservation or machine unlearning.

independent_verification.source_and_assumptions: Directly read p4 Eq3-4 and p11 A.1-A.3. The specified prototypes are unweighted k-center subsets. Pinned TensorSet.dist supplies no masses to wasserstein_distance_nd; ModelStore uses KMeans, a separate discrepancy. No source normalization restriction excludes the scalar finite set.
independent_verification.decisive_reasoning: For101 evenly spaced points0..0.01 plus isolated1 or2, any radius below.005 requires an outlier center and cannot cover the cluster with the remaining center. Radius.005 is uniquely attained at(.005,outlier). Uniform 1D W1(full)=1/102 but W1(centers)=.5, exceeding1/102+.01. Fresh exhaustive integer-coordinate enumeration confirms unique centers. The common13-extra-isolated-point extension gives k15, N115 and the same failure.
independent_verification.alternative_and_dependency: A nearest-center coupling works only if center weights retain their cluster masses; equal-center weighting deliberately suppresses common objects and cannot be presumed mass-preserving. Empirical near-equality in retrieval ablation does not prove the bound.
independent_verification.severity_and_repair: Major retained for central retrieval guarantee. Pushforward cluster masses give W(mu_i,nu_i)<=rho_i and reverse-triangle distance discrepancy<=rho_i+rho_j; this general repair changes the retrieval measure and does not guarantee topK ranking without separation. No benchmark failure inferred.

independent_verification.source_and_assumptions: Reread BaseImplantHook.forward and world-wise subclass, model.forward, completion-only trainer and VirtualHome chat construction. Also independently inspected custom modules/layers.py MultiheadAttention.forward: attn_mask=None, key_padding_mask=None, is_causal=False are defaults and passed unchanged to functional attention. This rules out a hidden causal default.
independent_verification.decisive_reasoning: Outer reasoning attention receives full same-sequence world states with no temporal mask. Teacher-forced assistant target tokens are in that sequence; later world states contain them, so an earlier query can access them through this new path. World-wise per-position integration does not remove the later sequence positions. Two equal-logit values(0,z) yield first output z/2, unlike causal0.
independent_verification.alternative_and_dependency: Internal LLM causal masks govern their own layers only. Prefix-only generation has no unavailable future tokens, so no evaluation-answer leakage is alleged. Initial small random attention weights do not structurally eliminate the trainable path; checkpoint effects and historical provenance remain unknown.
independent_verification.severity_and_repair: Minor release-level causality defect retained. Aligned temporal/padding masks and actual-path future-token invariance test are needed; no executed repaired system is claimed.
